message: No detected input validation: No schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards are applied to the data loaded from the trajectory cache or hyperparameters before use.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from a local SQLite file path with no checksum verification, signature validation, or authentication of the source.
No detected label flipping detection: No label distribution checks, label value validation, or label-noise detection tools are present anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.
No detected data poisoning defenses: The replay buffer and trajectory cache are loaded and used directly with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious samples.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads checkpoints with torch.load() from a local path but performs no hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision verification before loading the model weights.

No detected label distribution validation: There is no code that checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training; the replay buffer is loaded and sampled directly without any distribution validation.

No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no neural-cleanse-style trigger detection, activation-pattern analysis, or gradient anomaly detection to defend against backdoor injection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD, etc.) is imported or applied anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) or any adversarial stress-test logic are present anywhere in the code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no held-out test set isolation, signed/hashed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation; training and evaluation share the same replay buffer and environment data structures.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, shape checks, range checks, or schema validation are performed on incoming observations or replay buffer data before they are passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There are no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or threshold validations applied to the Q-values or any other model outputs in the visible inference path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a reinforcement learning system using a TransformerEncoderModel over math environment observations, not an LLM text-in/text-out system, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
